exposure: Intact perineum vs. perineal tear (within vaginal delivery group)
finding: Women with a history of vaginal delivery had higher prevalences and odds ratios for constipation compared to women with a history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women in the vaginal delivery group had higher prevalences and odds ratios for constipation, and a perineal tear during vaginal delivery further increased the odds ratio for constipation.
